0.0: I think it's time for you to increase your inner powers. When you acquire the ability to recognize the brightness or darkness of a spirit, then you'll be able to obtain the title of <Soul Conjurer>. Do you wish to be tested?

yes.0: In order to acquire the title of <Soul Conjurer>, you'll need to put yourself through some more severe challenges. Free the Skeleton Soldiers, the Skeleton Officers, Coolie Zombies, Miner Zombies, and Zombie Mushmoms from the shackles of their past...

no.0: I hope you can treat the spirits that are seeped in darkness.

1.0: I think you have noticed now, how slim the difference is between good and evil. But light can only exist with the presence of darkness... Know what I mean...?

default.0: They should have all been incinerated and be sent to nirvana, but I don't think you have enough experience to make that happen yet.
